title: Polaris AI Evaluation
description: Phase 17 (ADR-38). Scores come from eval/golden_dataset.json's keyword-presence check (eval/src/eval_harness/scoring.py), pushed to a Prometheus Pushgateway (deploy/platform/pushgateway/) by a manual or scheduled 'make eval-run'. See docs/ai-evaluation.md for the full methodology and its named limitations.

panels.title: Read this before trusting a number on this dashboard

options.content: **This is a keyword-presence heuristic, not a semantic understanding of correctness.** A response scores 1.0 only because the golden dataset's expected phrases appear in it as a case-insensitive substring (ADR-38) -- not because a judge (human or model) read the answer. **A Pushgateway holds only the *last* pushed value per backend** (`grouping_key={"backend": ...}`) until the next `make eval-run` -- the panels below show a flat line between runs, not continuous live traffic the way the other dashboards do; this is expected, not a stuck scrape. `mock` should score at (or very near) 1.0 every run -- a drop there means the harness itself broke, not that the model got worse (ADR-38: MockBackend's answers are a fixed lookup, not a measurement).
